rationale: Select narrow controls from the public action catalog rather than broad quarantine or legacy shutdown. OBS-20 shows tenant-owned report retrieval, while OBS-21 exposes a recent opaque report reference with separate owner identity evidence; cache-principal-partition directly targets that trust boundary and capability-audience-policy preserves valid preview/profile workflows while constraining capability reuse.
